correctness.rationale: The exact open-neighborhood signatures on the two bipartition shores are J\{i} and I\{j}. Nonempty, unique traces give the four occupancy cases. The all-code polynomial follows by allowing at most one entirely empty matched pair and removing precisely the exceptional invalid low-support assignments. For n>=5, Hall-style disjoint two-shore selection yields the complete n-1 and n inclusion-minimal families; at n=4 the direct 30+26 split yields 56. Independent direct adjacency enumeration of all 2^(2n) labeled subsets at n=4,5,6, testing deletion minimality without invoking the package criterion, produced L_4 coefficients (56,56,28,8,1) from degree4 and M_4=56z^4; L_5 coefficients 30,182,200,120,45,10,1 and M_5=30z^4+42z^5; M_6=120z^5+62z^6. The analytic proof covers all n>=4; finite checks are corroboration.
